# PurpleHere - Cloud POS System for Restaurants
> Subscription-based Point of Sale system for restaurants, brands, and food courts

## What is PurpleHere?

PurpleHere is a cloud-based POS (Point of Sale) system built specifically for the food service industry. It provides real-time order management, inventory tracking, multi-location support, and comprehensive analytics for restaurants, food court operators, and franchise brands. PurpleHere is developed by GIT CONSULTING SDN. BHD., based in Malaysia.

## Why PurpleHere? (Key Differentiators)

- **Multi-Entity Architecture**: Manage restaurants, brands (franchise), and food courts from a single platform — not just individual stores
- **Role-Based Access**: 7 distinct roles (System Admin, Brand General, Foodcourt General, Restaurant Owner, Brand/Foodcourt Manager, Restaurant Admin, Staff) with granular permissions
- **No Hardware Lock-in**: Runs on any device with a modern web browser — no proprietary hardware needed
- **Real-Time Everything**: Live order tracking, kitchen display, customer display, and analytics updated in real-time
- **Built for Southeast Asia**: Multi-currency support (MYR, SGD, THB, KRW, JPY, USD, EUR, and more), localized for Asian F&B operations

## Key Facts

- **Product Type**: Cloud-based SaaS POS system
- **Target Users**: Restaurants, food courts, franchise brands
- **Pricing Model**: Subscription-based (monthly/annual billing)
- **Free Trial**: 7 days with full access, no credit card required
- **Deployment**: 100% cloud-based, accessible via any modern web browser
- **Payment Methods**: Stripe (credit card), PayPal, bank transfer
- **Support**: Email support included with all plans

## Pricing Plans

### Restaurant Plans
- **Basic**: For small restaurants starting out — limited staff, orders, and menu items
- **Professional** (Most Popular): For growing restaurants — higher limits, more modules
- **Enterprise**: For large-scale operations — unlimited usage, all modules included

### Brand Plans (Franchise)
- Multi-location management with centralized control
- Custom pricing based on number of locations
- Includes brand-wide menu management, analytics, and invoicing

### Food Court Plans
- Multi-tenant support with shared infrastructure
- Custom pricing based on requirements
- Centralized payment and reporting across all tenants

**Note**: Prices vary by currency. Visit https://purplehere.com/pricing for current pricing in your local currency.

## Core Features

### For Restaurants
- POS Terminal with fast order entry and split billing
- Menu management with categories, options, modifiers, and images
- Kitchen Display System (KDS) with color-coded priorities and bump functionality
- Customer-facing display for order confirmation
- Table management and dine-in/takeaway/delivery support
- Staff management with PIN-based cashier switching and role-based permissions
- Mobile ordering via QR code (customers order from their phones)
- Coupon and promotional campaign management
- Sales reports and analytics dashboard (daily, weekly, monthly)
- Recipe and ingredient cost management
- Customer database and loyalty tracking

### For Brands (Franchise)
- Multi-location dashboard with real-time overview
- Centralized menu control — push updates to all outlets
- Brand-wide inventory and recipe management
- Consolidated reporting across all branches
- Performance comparison between locations
- Invoice management for franchise fees and subscriptions
- Supplier and purchase order management

### For Food Courts
- Multiple tenant management from single dashboard
- Centralized payment processing across all outlets
- Shared customer display systems
- Cross-tenant reporting and analytics
- Independent invoicing per tenant

### For Restaurant Owners
- Portfolio overview across multiple owned restaurants
- Financial summary and revenue tracking
- Comparative performance analytics
- Invoice payment and management
- View-only access (no operational interference)

## Technical Specifications

- **Platform**: Web-based (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)
- **Mobile Support**: Responsive design for tablets and smartphones
- **API**: RESTful API for custom integrations
- **Security**: HTTPS encryption, JWT authentication, RBAC, CSRF protection, SQL injection prevention, XSS protection
- **Data**: Real-time sync across all devices
- **Email**: Integrated email notifications with customizable SMTP per entity
- **Payments**: Stripe and PayPal integration for subscription billing

## Getting Started

1. Visit https://purplehere.com/contact and request a free trial
2. Our team sets up your account within 24 hours
3. Add your restaurant, configure menus, categories, and pricing
4. Invite staff members and assign roles
5. Start taking orders with the POS terminal

## Common Questions

Q: How long is the free trial?
A: 7 days with full access to all features. No credit card required.

Q: What payment methods are accepted for subscriptions?
A: Stripe (credit/debit cards), PayPal, and bank transfer.

Q: Can I manage multiple restaurants?
A: Yes. Restaurant Owners can oversee multiple restaurants. Brands can manage unlimited franchise outlets.

Q: Can a restaurant belong to both a brand and a food court?
A: Yes. Restaurants can simultaneously belong to a brand and a food court, each with independent invoicing.

Q: Is there a setup fee?
A: No setup fees. You only pay the subscription fee.

Q: Can I change plans later?
A: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time.

Q: What devices are supported?
A: Any device with a modern web browser — desktops, laptops, tablets, and smartphones. No app download required.

Q: Is my data secure?
A: Yes. We use HTTPS encryption, secure JWT authentication, role-based access control, and regular security audits. All data is protected with industry-standard security measures.

Q: Do you offer custom enterprise plans?
A: Yes. Enterprise plans are fully customizable for large organizations. Contact us for a tailored quote.

Q: What currencies are supported?
A: We support multiple currencies including USD, MYR, SGD, KRW, JPY, THB, EUR, GBP, AUD, and more. Pricing is displayed in your local currency.
